WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), first_pass AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill_size,
         p.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS margin1
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark
  FROM first_pass
), final_orders AS (
  SELECT f.avg_fill_size, f.margin1,
         f.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS margin2
  FROM first_pass f
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE f.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS average_per_order_fill_size,
       AVG(margin1) AS average_margin_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(margin2) AS average_margin_over_second_benchmark
FROM final_orders;
